title: Avoid CBMC aborts when copying padded unions with zero-sized fields

reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the padded-union lowering change. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR addresses #5175 by changing Kani’s union lowering to avoid CBMC aborts when copying padded unions with zero-sized fields. The workaround preserves logical field types while leaving nonzero payloads and unpadded unions unchanged. **Changes:** - Represent zero-sized payloads inside padded union wrappers with the existing empty unit struct, using rustc layout information. - Add regression coverage for typed copies, nested and aligned zero-sized fields, indexing, and recursive types. - Add expected verification results
